name: Collateral Data Status Advice V 01
definition: The CollateralDataStatusAdvice message is sent by the executing party to an instructing party (the requestor) to provide information of a request on collateral management reference data.||Usage: |It aims at informing about the status of the request.

MessageHeader.name: Message Header
MessageHeader.definition: Common business identification for the message.

StatusReason.name: Status Reason
StatusReason.definition: Specifies the reason for the status report.

StatusReasonAndFinancialInstrument.name: Status Reason And Financial Instrument
StatusReasonAndFinancialInstrument.definition: Specifies the reason for the status report per financial instrument and eligibility set.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.

StatusReasonPresenceRule.definition: If Status Reason is present then Status Reason And Financial Instrument cannot be present

StatusReasonAndFinancialInstrumentPresen.definition: If Status Reason And Financial Instrument is present then Status Reason cannot be present
